title: Data Analyst
description: Uses data queries, analysis and visualization to help answer business or research questions.
starter_project: Analyze a public dataset, clean it, answer three questions and present the findings in a small dashboard.
evidence_note: Career-level skill guide, not a guarantee of employer requirements. Compare against dated job postings.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Organizes and visualizes business data to support decisions and track performance.
starter_project: Create a sales or student-performance dashboard from a public or synthetic dataset, with clear metrics and written conclusions.
evidence_note: Career-level skill guide, not a guarantee of employer requirements. Compare against dated job postings.

title: Data Scientist
description: Uses statistics, programming and analytical methods to investigate data and develop models.
starter_project: Explore a public dataset, define a question, clean the data, build a simple baseline model and explain its limitations.
evidence_note: Career-level skill guide, not a guarantee of employer requirements. Compare against dated job postings.

title: Data Engineer
description: Builds and maintains reliable processes and systems that collect, transform and prepare data for use.
starter_project: Build a small pipeline that loads public CSV data, validates it, transforms it and stores it in a local database.
evidence_note: Career-level skill guide, not a guarantee of employer requirements. Compare against dated job postings.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Develops, tests and integrates machine-learning models into software and data products.
starter_project: Train and evaluate a simple classifier on a public dataset, document the baseline and make a small demo.
evidence_note: Career-level skill guide, not a guarantee of employer requirements. Compare against dated job postings.

title: Applied AI / Generative AI Developer
description: Builds applications that use AI models to help users complete specific tasks, with attention to reliability and evaluation.
starter_project: Build a small AI-assisted study tool, add input checks and a fallback, and test it against a set of example questions.
evidence_note: Career-level skill guide, not a guarantee of employer requirements. Compare against dated job postings.
